Household Recycling Guide

Blue bins are for paper, cardboard, cans, and plastic bottles. Please rinse containers and flatten boxes before putting them in the bin.

Glass goes in the green box, which is collected every two weeks. Food waste goes in the small brown caddy and is collected weekly.

Soft plastics such as bags and wrappers cannot be recycled at the kerb. They can be taken to collection points at large supermarkets.

Batteries must never go in any bin; take them to the recycling centre on Station Road.
